title: First Shift: Internal Preview
body: Open the Pack #2 Terminal dashboard, confirm the internal-preview badge, read What Now, then complete the first Lens scan. This route is for launcher review only.
commonIssueText: If Lens or HoloMap is missing, stay on Terminal and Index guidance; optional modules should warn rather than block the preview.
nextStep: Complete Foundry Orientation and claim the starter grid kit.
